curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: recognise the correct form of words to be used in writing simple sentences

interactions.feedback: Yes! Computer has the correct word form.
interactions.retryHint: Look for every sound and letter in com-pu-ter.

interactions.prompt: Match each mixed-up word to its correct form.
interactions.feedback: Great repairs! Correct word forms help sentences make sense.
interactions.retryHint: Say the intended word, then check its letter order.

interactions.prompt: Use the correct words to build a sentence.
interactions.retryHint: Start with who, then the action, then the thing.

interactions.prompt: Which sentence uses correctly formed words?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Every word has its proper form.
interactions.retryHint: Check the spelling of the, phone, is and new.

interactions.prompt: Sort the word forms before writing.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then its group.
interactions.feedback: Excellent checking! You found the words ready for a sentence.
interactions.retryHint: Think of how each familiar technology word is normally written.

interactions.prompt: Choose the correct words for: My ___ is ___.
interactions.feedback: Sentence lab complete! Correct word forms make clear writing.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the two familiar words with complete spelling.
